## react-big-schedule 9.0.3

- **Fix: switching to the vertical view froze the page.** Going from Week, Month, Quarter or Year to Vertical kept the old date range and built hourly rows for all of it (a whole year of them). The vertical view now always opens on a single day.
- **Fix: resource rows misaligned with their events.** A CSS reset that makes every `svg` a block element (Tailwind's preflight, for example) stacked the expander icon above the resource name, so group rows were taller than their event rows. Icons inside the scheduler are inline again.
- **Fix: collapsing a resource group left its event rows on screen.** The visible rows are now recomputed whenever the scheduler data changes.
- **Fix: the view or date spinner never switched off in React StrictMode (development).**
- **Fix: stray scrollbar over the timeline header** on systems with overlay scrollbars.
- **Mobile:** the Day / Week / Month / ... tabs no longer overflow their card; they scroll sideways.
